neonatal2025.title: Neonatal Nutrition Assessment
neonatal2025.kind: Informational practice tool, not an ASPEN clinical guideline
neonatal2025.tables: All headers, rows, footnotes and qualifications on all five pages read, including anthropometrics, PN/EN assessment ranges, physical examination, micronutrient differential and proposed malnutrition indicators.
neonatal2025.adoption: Serial growth/maturity-appropriate chart and fluid/illness/medicine confounders from page1; professional-judgment qualification from page4; unvalidated proposed criteria and first-two-week limitations from page5. No numeric nutrient ranges, diagnosis cutoffs, chart age cutoffs or fixed weighing schedules adopted.
neonatal2025.qualification: Explicitly not based on ASPEN Board Approved documents or developed through ASPEN guideline processes. Proposed2018 neonatal malnutrition criteria remain unvalidated. Page5 weight-for-age z decline and weight-gain velocity inappropriate for first2weeks; nutrient intake preferred then. Not generalized to all infants or used to diagnose malnutrition from one weight.
